top_signals.title: The $150 Billion Catch in US Shipbuilding
top_signals.summary: South Korea pledged $150 billion to revive US shipbuilding. But with the first shipbuilding contract between Hanwha Group and the US Navy worth only $269 million, it’s Washington’s turn to take the lead to ensure that promise is fulfilled, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Juliana Liu says. top_signals.title: Hybrid sales rise while battery electric sales remain lower after tax credit expiration
top_signals.summary: In the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), 23% of new light-duty vehicles sold in the United States were hybrid electric, battery electric, or plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, down slightly from 24% in 3Q25. Between 3Q25 and 3Q26, hybrid electric vehicles continued to gain market share, reaching 16% of light-duty vehicle sales. Growth of hybrid electric vehicle sales has slowed this quarter as the average transaction price for a new vehicle passed $50,000-the first time this price has been reached so far this year, according to Kelley Blue Book.

top_signals.title: Global Power Grid Expansion Surges 50% to Record High
top_signals.summary: Utilities built a total of over 21,000 km of new transmission lines last year, the International Renewable Energy Agency reported this week at COP31, citing data from a group called the Utilities for Net Zero Alliance. This is 50% more than the new transmission lines installed during the previous year, IRENA noted in its report. “Power grids will make or break not only the energy transition but also the world’s ambition to raise global electrification to 35% by 2035, as championed by the Turkish COP31 Presidency,” said the director-general…
